name: Nigrescent-Reliquary

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws tectonic rift valleys, patient as erosion itself.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
the ancient alien ruins still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
